questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “oxygen” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "kislorod" ni o'xshash fikrlardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: strong oxidizing agent, burns more strongly in oxygen than in air
A complex substance of two elements, one of which is oxygen
choicesUz: kuchli oksidlovchi vosita, havoga qaraganda kislorodda kuchliroq yonadi
Ikki elementdan iborat murakkab modda, ulardan biri kislorod
explanationEn: Oxygen is a strong oxidizing agent; combustion in oxygen is stronger than in air.
explanationUz: Kislorod kuchli oksidlovchi vositadir; kislorodda yonish havoga qaraganda kuchliroqdir.
